title: The installed CLI follows the active connection
when: A connected server ships a new release, or a command warns that this CLI is older than the release its active connection serves
need: Only the relay for the machine's active_env moves the installed CLI, to exactly the release that plane serves, on relay start; outcomes land in operator-cli-follow.json in the relay state directory. Commands sent to another env with --env or YOKE_ENV neither follow nor warn. The prod marker on db-admin connections plays no part.
surface: Install -> upgrade instructions; one stderr warning per command naming yoke update --version.
review: Source and unit tests; live proof is the release's post-deploy QA.
